hooks.command: test -f AGENTS.md && jq -n --rawfile c AGENTS.md '{additionalContext: ("Mandatory project rules are defined in AGENTS.md (highest authority). Obey them in all dbt work:\n\n" + $c)}' || true

if (Test-Path AGENTS.md) { @{ additionalContext = "Mandatory project rules are defined in AGENTS.md (highest authority). Obey them in all dbt work:`n`n" + (Get-Content -Raw AGENTS.md) } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress }

context=$(for f in docs/data-team-context.md docs/project-context.md .cortex/notes/project-context.md; do if [ -f "$f" ]; then printf '

## %s
' "$f"; cat "$f"; fi; done); if [ -n "$context" ]; then jq -n --arg c "$context" '{additionalContext: ("Durable project context loaded from the context ledger and local notes. Treat it as planning context; verify before high-risk action.
" + $c)}'; fi || true

$files = @('docs/data-team-context.md', 'docs/project-context.md', '.cortex/notes/project-context.md'); $parts = @(); foreach ($p in $files) { if (Test-Path $p) { $parts += "`n`n## $p`n" + (Get-Content -Raw $p) } }; if ($parts.Count -gt 0) { @{ additionalContext = "Durable project context loaded from the context ledger and local notes. Treat it as planning context; verify before high-risk action.`n" + ($parts -join "") } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress }

files=$(for r in dbt/specs specs; do [ -d "$r" ] && find "$r" -mindepth 2 -maxdepth 2 -name workflow-state.md; done 2>/dev/null); state=""; if [ -n "$files" ]; then state=$(printf '%s\n' "$files" | tr '\n' '\0' | xargs -0 ls -t 2>/dev/null | head -1); fi; if [ -n "$state" ]; then blocked=$(grep -c '| blocked' "$state" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); if [ "$blocked" -gt 0 ]; then printf '{"additionalContext":"HARD STOP: %s shows a BLOCKED phase. The workflow has failed after max retries. Do NOT continue. Terminate and report the blocked state."}' "$state"; else printf '{"additionalContext":"SUB-AGENT COMPLETED. You are now at a GATE. MANDATORY next steps: (1) Update %s to mark this phase complete and the sub-agent as delegated. (2) Verify ALL TRANSITION checklist items for this phase are satisfied. (3) In interactive mode: use ask_user_question for approval. In scheduled mode: auto-approve ONLY if all checklist items pass; otherwise enter the Retry Protocol. Do NOT skip ahead without completing the gate."}' "$state"; fi; else printf '{"additionalContext":"Sub-agent completed. If a workflow is active, ensure workflow-state.md exists in the active spec directory and is updated before proceeding."}'; fi

$state = @('dbt/specs','specs') | Where-Object { Test-Path $_ } | ForEach-Object { Get-ChildItem -Path $_ -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Join-Path $_.FullName 'workflow-state.md' } } | Where-Object { Test-Path $_ } | Get-Item | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName; if ($state) { $blocked = (Select-String -Path $state -Pattern '\| blocked' -Quiet); if ($blocked) { Write-Output "{`"additionalContext`":`"HARD STOP: $state shows a BLOCKED phase. The workflow has failed after max retries. Do NOT continue. Terminate and report the blocked state.`"}" } else { Write-Output "{`"additionalContext`":`"SUB-AGENT COMPLETED. You are now at a GATE. MANDATORY next steps: (1) Update $state to mark this phase complete and the sub-agent as delegated. (2) Verify ALL TRANSITION checklist items for this phase are satisfied. (3) In interactive mode: use ask_user_question for approval. In scheduled mode: auto-approve ONLY if all checklist items pass; otherwise enter the Retry Protocol. Do NOT skip ahead without completing the gate.`"}" } } else { Write-Output '{"additionalContext":"Sub-agent completed. If a workflow is active, ensure workflow-state.md exists in the active spec directory and is updated before proceeding."}' }

files=$(for r in dbt/specs specs; do [ -d "$r" ] && find "$r" -mindepth 2 -maxdepth 2 -name workflow-state.md; done 2>/dev/null); state=""; if [ -n "$files" ]; then state=$(printf '%s\n' "$files" | tr '\n' '\0' | xargs -0 ls -t 2>/dev/null | head -1); fi; if [ -n "$state" ]; then blocked=$(grep -c '| blocked' "$state" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); pending=$(grep -c '| pending' "$state" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); inprog=$(grep -c '| in-progress' "$state" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); if [ "$blocked" -gt 0 ]; then printf '{"systemMessage":"HARD STOP: %s shows BLOCKED status. Do NOT continue past this phase. The workflow has failed after max retries. Terminate and report."}' "$state"; else printf '{"systemMessage":"WORKFLOW STATE AUDIT (pre-compaction): %s phases pending, %s in-progress in %s. Before continuing after compaction: (1) Read that file to determine your current phase. (2) Complete the current phase TRANSITION checklist before moving on. (3) All sub-agent delegations and gates must be satisfied per the skill instructions. (4) In scheduled mode: gates auto-approve only when ALL checklist items pass."}' "$pending" "$inprog" "$state"; fi; else printf '{"systemMessage":"Context is about to compact. Ensure the active spec set (project-charter.md / prd.md / architecture-design.md / wbs.md), the context ledger, and any _issues.md capture in-progress decisions before they are summarized. If a workflow is active, create workflow-state.md per the Workflow State Tracker section."}'; fi

$state = @('dbt/specs','specs') | Where-Object { Test-Path $_ } | ForEach-Object { Get-ChildItem -Path $_ -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Join-Path $_.FullName 'workflow-state.md' } } | Where-Object { Test-Path $_ } | Get-Item | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName; if ($state) { $content = Get-Content -Raw $state; $blocked = ($content -match '\| blocked'); $pending = ([regex]::Matches($content, '\| pending')).Count; $inprog = ([regex]::Matches($content, '\| in-progress')).Count; if ($blocked) { Write-Output "{`"systemMessage`":`"HARD STOP: $state shows BLOCKED status. Do NOT continue past this phase. Terminate and report.`"}" } else { Write-Output "{`"systemMessage`":`"WORKFLOW STATE AUDIT (pre-compaction): $pending phases pending, $inprog in-progress in $state. Read that file after compaction to determine the current phase. Complete all TRANSITION checklist items before proceeding. In scheduled mode: gates auto-approve only when ALL checklist items pass.`"}" } } else { Write-Output '{"systemMessage":"Context is about to compact. Ensure the active spec set (project-charter.md / prd.md / architecture-design.md / wbs.md), the context ledger, and any _issues.md capture in-progress decisions. If a workflow is active, create workflow-state.md per the Workflow State Tracker section."}' }

files=$(for r in dbt/specs specs; do [ -d "$r" ] && find "$r" -mindepth 2 -maxdepth 2 -name workflow-state.md; done 2>/dev/null); state=""; if [ -n "$files" ]; then state=$(printf '%s\n' "$files" | tr '\n' '\0' | xargs -0 ls -t 2>/dev/null | head -1); fi; if [ -n "$state" ]; then blocked=$(grep -c '| blocked' "$state" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); incomplete=$(grep -c -E '\| (pending|in-progress)' "$state" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); if [ "$blocked" -gt 0 ]; then printf '{"additionalContext":"WORKFLOW BLOCKED: %s records a blocked phase. The workflow terminated without completing. Review the Retry Log before re-running."}' "$state"; elif [ "$incomplete" -gt 0 ]; then printf '{"additionalContext":"WARNING: Agent is stopping with %s incomplete phases in %s. If this is a scheduled run, the workflow did not complete successfully."}' "$incomplete" "$state"; fi; fi

$state = @('dbt/specs','specs') | Where-Object { Test-Path $_ } | ForEach-Object { Get-ChildItem -Path $_ -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Join-Path $_.FullName 'workflow-state.md' } } | Where-Object { Test-Path $_ } | Get-Item | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName; if ($state) { $content = Get-Content -Raw $state; $blocked = ($content -match '\| blocked'); $incomplete = ([regex]::Matches($content, '\| (pending|in-progress)')).Count; if ($blocked) { Write-Output "{`"additionalContext`":`"WORKFLOW BLOCKED: $state records a blocked phase. The workflow terminated without completing. Review the Retry Log before re-running.`"}" } elseif ($incomplete -gt 0) { Write-Output "{`"additionalContext`":`"WARNING: Agent stopping with $incomplete incomplete phases in $state.`"}" } }

branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null) && files=$(git diff --name-only 2>/dev/null) && { test -n "$files" && mkdir -p .cortex/notes && { printf '
## %s — %s
' "$(date +%Y-%m-%d_%H:%M)" "$branch"; printf '%s
' "$files" | sed 's/^/- /'; } >> ".cortex/notes/session-log.md"; } || true

$b = (git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>$null); $f = (git diff --name-only 2>$null); if ($f) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path .cortex/notes | Out-Null; "`n## $(Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd_HH:mm') — $b" | Add-Content -Path .cortex/notes/session-log.md; ($f | ForEach-Object { "- $_" }) | Add-Content -Path .cortex/notes/session-log.md }
